result.topic_en: Riemann counts the conditions on the coefficients of a linear differential equation needed for the solutions near singular points to have a prescribed form of expansion (indicial equation with exponents differing by integers, logarithm-free solutions), and computes the resulting number of conditions and of arbitrary constants.

methods.what: Indicial (characteristic) equation at a singular point; require all roots to be distinct positive integers so the solutions are expandable in integer powers (no logarithms), giving n conditions per singular point
Linear relation among initial derivatives when the leading coefficient vanishes
Differentiating the relation and eliminating via the differential equation gives conditions on coefficients
Counting constants in the coefficients versus conditions to find number of free parameters
